## SignRequest.algorithm property

Override the hash algorithm (`'sha256'`<!-- -->, `'sha384'`<!-- -->, or `'sha512'`<!-- -->). Ignored for Ed25519/Ed448 keys where the algorithm is implicit. Non-Edwards keys (RSA, EC) default to `'sha256'` when omitted. Weak algorithms (e.g. `'md5'`<!-- -->, `'sha1'`<!-- -->) are rejected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
algorithm?: string | undefined;
```
